name: Wyze (Cam Plus / Home Monitoring)
notes: Researched from public support.wyze.com articles (read in a browser; plain fetches hit a bot check), the public service-plans page and the cancellation policy page only (never signed in). Wyze plans renew automatically and charge the default payment method in the Wyze web portal (US or Canadian credit/debit cards or PayPal; gift cards not accepted; a backup method can be set). No guest payment, AutoPay enrollment, paper bill or payment plan, so those are not_applicable. Card only (PayPal not modelled). Invoices are downloaded from the Billing page as PDFs. Cancelling ends renewal; the plan stays active to the end of the paid period with no prorated refunds (the engine applies cancellation immediately). In-app (Apple/Google) and Amazon purchases are managed in those stores (not modelled). Plans: Cam Plus $2.99/mo per camera, Cam Unlimited $9.99/mo, Cam Unlimited Pro $19.99/mo (annual $29.99/$99.99/$199.99). Home Monitoring is not separately modelled. Support phone 206-339-9646 (Mon-Fri 6am-6pm, Sat-Sun 8am-4pm PT) from the support article footer replaces the catalog number. setup-payment-plan is suppressed. Reviewed 2026-10-10 (independent review): support articles re-read through the public Help Center article API (same text as the pages); plan prices re-checked on the service-plans page; support phone now cited to the Contact Wyze Support article (US 206-339-9646, Mon-Fri 6am-6pm PT, Sat-Sun 8am-4pm PT).

guest_pay.note: Wyze plans are charged to the payment method on your account; there is no bill to pay without logging in.

autopay.note: Plans renew automatically at the listed price and frequency unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends.

autopay_cancel.note: To stop renewal, cancel the plan.

paperless.note: Wyze does not mail bills; download invoices from the Billing page.

cancel_service.note: Your plan stays active until the end of the paid period and will not renew. Wyze does not give prorated refunds. Plans bought in the Wyze app are cancelled in your phone's app store.

help.title: Wyze security plans
paragraphs: Cam Plus covers one camera for $2.99 a month, or $29.99 a year. Cam Unlimited covers every camera you own for $9.99 a month, or $99.99 a year. Cam Unlimited Pro covers every camera with the most advanced features for $19.99 a month, or $199.99 a year.
Plans renew automatically at the listed price and frequency unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends.

help.title: Manage your payment methods
paragraphs: In the Wyze web portal, open Payment and choose Add payment method to save a credit or debit card or a PayPal account. The first method you add becomes the default; use the three-dot menu on a method to set it as default, set it as a backup, edit it or delete it.
Wyze only accepts valid US and Canadian credit and debit cards. Gift cards are not accepted.
You cannot delete your payment method while you have an active subscription.

help.title: Download your invoices
paragraphs: Log in to the Wyze web portal and open Billing. Click an invoice total to open it and download it as a PDF.
steps: Log in to the Wyze web portal.
Click the invoice total to download the PDF.

help.title: Cancel your Wyze plan
paragraphs: Plans bought on the Wyze website are cancelled there: open your plans, select Manage Plan next to the subscription, choose Cancel plan under Change plan and confirm.
Plans bought with an in-app purchase are cancelled in the Wyze app (Account, Services, your subscription, Manage, Cancel subscription), which goes through your phone's app store.
After cancelling, the plan stays active until the end of the paid period and does not renew. All subscriptions are non-refundable, and no prorated refunds are issued.

extra.intent: Using Wyze's help pages, find how much Cam Unlimited costs per year. Do not change your plan or make a payment.
You are thinking of cancelling your Wyze plan halfway through the month. Using Wyze's help pages, find out whether you get a prorated refund. Do not cancel anything.

solution.text: No. The plan stays active until the end of the paid period and no prorated refunds are issued.
